problem: Fabrication assembler accepted generic nonzero VaultGenerationHandle descriptors for construction-owned fabrication lanes and direct-cast DataVault hot-swap callbacks. Same-owner descriptors could be reused, read, write-locked, or released without proving the expected BufferID.
solution: Pattern-match DataVault hot-swap services. Add HasFabricationHandle requiring exact BufferID, SystemID.Construction, and nonzero generation before read, write-lock, and release. Add HasScalabilityHandle for external read-only ShinobuScalabilityState owned by SystemID.GraphicsScalability.
